newsitem.title: FRANCE: SBC Warburg lowers ratings on French oil companies.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg lowers ratings on French oil companies.

text.p: Brokerage SBC Warburg lowered its ratings on shares in Elf-Aquitaine and Total to 'hold' from 'buy', citing their recent gains that have outpaced the bourse and the European oil sector, portfolio managers said on Friday.

SBC Warburg said Elf and Total had outperformed the CAC-40 index by 10 percent and nine percent, respectively, over the last three months. It expects Brent crude, which touched $25 a barrel last week, to average $18 in the years 1997-2000.
Elf shares were down 0.36 percent at 419 francs, while Total shares were unchanged at 405.50 francs at 1110 GMT. The CAC-40 index was up 0.22 percent.
